## Graduate students

If you are interested in how the brain works and in what we do in the lab, feel free to reach out at <arthurzhao@nd.edu>. We suggest applying through one of the graduate programs below at the University of Notre Dame.

Applications go through Notre Dame's
[GradConnect portal](https://gradconnect.nd.edu/apply/); see each program's
page for deadlines and requirements.

- [PhD in Physics](https://graduateschool.nd.edu/degree-programs/physics-phd---doctoral/),
  [Department of Physics and Astronomy](https://physics.nd.edu/graduate/apply/)
- [PhD in Applied and Computational Mathematics and Statistics](https://graduateschool.nd.edu/degree-programs/applied-and-computational-mathematics-and-statistics-phd---doctoral/),
  [Department of Applied and Computational Mathematics and Statistics (ACMS)](https://acms.nd.edu/graduate/phd-programs/)
- [PhD in Integrated Biomedical Sciences](https://graduateschool.nd.edu/degree-programs/integrated-biomedical-sciences-phd---doctoral/),
  [Integrated Biomedical Sciences (IBMS) Program](https://ibms.nd.edu/apply-now/)

## Postdocs

Please email me your CV and a brief description of your research interests.
